_comment: A real 402, captured from https://kaspai.win/compute on 2026-09-10 by
Kept because a claim made to another project should be reproducible by them.
This body announces x402Version 2 and carries a v1 quote: `extra` holds
{nonce, facilitator} where kaspa-x402 v2 wants {binding, finality, profile,
transactionEncoding, payToScriptPublicKey}. The top level duplicates the v1
fields (amountSompi, nonce, facilitator) beside the v2 ones (amount, extra,
resource), which reads as a migration in progress rather than a mistake.
Their own client, kaspa-x402@0.1.3, declares x402Version: 1 in its types and
reads accepts[0] without validating, so nothing on their side would notice.
